description: The DfT aviation statistics tables (AVI series) provide UK air transport statistics. The AVI01 tables cover activity at UK airports: air traffic at UK airports since 1950, traffic by operation type and airport, punctuality at selected airports, international passengers by last or next country, transfer passengers, mode of transport to the airport, purpose of travel and a map of UK airports. Further series cover UK airline outputs and employment (AVI02), traffic at major airports worldwide (AVI03), aviation accident casualties and AIRPROX incidents (AVI04) and air passenger experience of security screening (AVI05). Coverage is the United Kingdom. Access: free ODS spreadsheets on GOV.UK, updated in August 2026, with the next AVI01 to AVI04 release due in December 2026; Esri UK also publishes a 2015 feature service of table AVI0101 with airport locations under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Caveats: most tables are annual aggregates, the feature service copy was created in 2015, and the security screening series may be discontinued. It supports airport capacity planning, disruption and punctuality analysis and aviation incident studies, and complements the UK DfT maritime and road statistics catalogued here.
